newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP says copper is a challenge.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP says copper is a challenge.

text.p: Broken Hill Co Proprietary Co Ltd managing director John Prescott said on Tuesday that the "real challenge" facing the company was the copper price and the company's performance in the copper sector.

"I think that at the moment the real challenge for BHP is the copper price and the general peformance of our cooper group," Prescott told Reuters. "At the moment we're able to sell all the copper we're able to produce... We'll continue to review all the impications of that as the months roll on," Prescott said. BHP is the world's second largest copper producer behind Chile's state-run Coproracion Nacional del Cobre (Codelco.)
